      public BottleneckStatus(String areaName, String equipmentName, String constraintName, double utilization, double currentValue, double designValue, boolean minimumConstraint, String unit, boolean feasible)

    • BottleneckStatus

      public BottleneckStatus(String areaName, String equipmentName, String constraintName, double utilization, double currentValue, double designValue, boolean minimumConstraint, String dataSource, String unit, boolean feasible)
      Creates a bottleneck status with explicit limit direction and provenance.
      Parameters:
      areaName - process area name
      equipmentName - equipment name
      constraintName - constraint name
      utilization - utilization fraction
      currentValue - current constraint value
      designValue - reported design or minimum limit
      minimumConstraint - true when values below the limit are worse
      dataSource - provenance of the reported limit
      unit - constraint unit
      feasible - true when utilization is less than or equal to one

    • BottleneckStatus

      public BottleneckStatus(String areaName, String equipmentName, String constraintName, double utilization, double currentValue, double designValue, boolean minimumConstraint, String dataSource, boolean confidenceSet, double confidence, boolean validityRangeSet, double validityMinimum, double validityMaximum, String unit, boolean feasible)
      Creates a bottleneck status with evidence-quality and scalar-validity metadata. Enabled metadata that is non-finite, outside the confidence range, or has reversed bounds is normalized to the explicit unset state. Applicability is derived from the snapshotted current value and retained bounds.
      Parameters:
      areaName - process area name
      equipmentName - equipment name
      constraintName - constraint name
      utilization - utilization fraction
      currentValue - current constraint value
      designValue - reported design or minimum limit
      minimumConstraint - true when values below the limit are worse
      dataSource - provenance of the reported limit
      confidenceSet - true to retain a finite confidence in the range [0, 1]
      confidence - evidence-quality confidence, or NaN when unset
      validityRangeSet - true to retain finite, ordered scalar validity bounds
      validityMinimum - lower inclusive validity bound, or NaN when unset
      validityMaximum - upper inclusive validity bound, or NaN when unset
      unit - constraint unit
      feasible - true when utilization is less than or equal to one

    • getEvidenceApplicability

      public ProcessModelSimulationEvaluator.BottleneckStatus.EvidenceApplicability getEvidenceApplicability()
      Gets the applicability of the evidence basis at the snapshotted operating point.

      This diagnostic does not alter utilization, feasibility, or ranking. Confidence remains an evidence-quality annotation and is not interpreted as a probability of safe operation.

      Returns:
      applicability of the scalar validity range
